entries.title: Psalms 91:1
segments: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High shall rest [under] the shadow of the Almighty.

entries.title: Psalms 91:2
segments: I will say of the LORD, my refuge and my fortress; my God; in Him I will trust.

entries.title: Psalms 91:3
segments: Surely He will deliver you from the fowler's trap [and] from the destroying plague.

entries.title: Psalms 91:4
segments: He shall cover you with His feathers, and under His wings you shall trust. His truth [shall be your] shield, and buckler.

entries.title: Psalms 91:5
segments: You shall not fear the terror by night; nor because of the arrow [that] flies by day;

entries.title: Psalms 91:6
segments: [nor] for the plague [that] walks in darkness, of the destruction laying waste at noonday.

entries.title: Psalms 91:7
segments: A thousand shall fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; it shall not come near you.

entries.title: Psalms 91:8
segments: Only with your eyes you shall look and see the reward of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 91:9
segments: Because You, O LORD, [are] My refuge; [if] you have made the Most High Your dwelling-place,

entries.title: Psalms 91:10
segments: no evil shall befall You, nor shall any plague come near Your dwelling.

entries.title: Psalms 91:11
segments: For He shall give His angels charge over You, to keep You in all Your ways.

entries.title: Psalms 91:12
segments: They shall bear You up in [their] hands, lest You dash your foot against a stone.

entries.title: Psalms 91:13
segments: You shall tread on the lion and adder; the young lion and the jackal You shall trample underfoot.

entries.title: Psalms 91:14
segments: Because He has set His love on Me, therefore I will deliver him; I will set Him on high, because He has known My name.

entries.title: Psalms 91:15
segments: He shall call on Me, and I will answer Him; I [will be] with Him in trouble; I will deliver Him, and honor Him.

entries.title: Psalms 91:16
segments: With long life I will satisfy him, and show him My salvation.
